Once upon a time, there was a big, soft cushion. It was very soft and comfortable. It lived in a nice park with other kids.
One day, a little girl named Lily came to the park. She was very happy to see the cushion. She sat down on the cushion and started to play. But then, the cushion started to talk.
"Please, don't be upset," said the cushion. Lily was very surprised. The cushion said, "I can make you happy." Lily was very surprised. She had never met a talking cushion before.
Lily and the cushion became best friends. They played all day long. After that, Lily would visit the cushion every day. The cushion was happy to have a friend. And they lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a big dream. She wanted to go to the zoo. Lily put on her shoes and went outside.
On her way to the zoo, she saw a big tree. Lily wanted to climb the tree. She took a step and gazed at the tree. "Wow, this tree is so big!" she said.
Lily started to climb the tree. She found a big branch. But then, she saw a dead tree. The tree was sad. "Why are you sad?" Lily asked the tree. The tree said, "I want to move. I am dead. I am dead." Lily thought for a moment and said, "I can help you move the dead tree."
Lily and the tree became friends. The tree moved and the dead tree was happy. "Thank you, Lily," said the tree. "Your dream is gone." And they played together at the zoo all day.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Patty. She was three years old and very curious. One day, Patty went outside to look at the sunshine. It was so bright, and the sunshine was so warm. Patty was very happy and she put on a warm coat and a hat. 
On a mild night, Patty had an idea. She wanted to play a game with her friends in the sunshine. So, she hid behind a tree and waited for her friends to come. 
Patty called out, "Come out, friends! Let's play!" 
Her friends quickly ran out to join her. They all ran around the yard, playing games and running around. 
When it was time to go, Patty was very tired but happy. She had found a way to play the game. She closed her eyes and fell asleep, dreaming of the day she found a way to have more fun.
